---
name: generators-are-source-of-truth
description: Pelagios map.bin / map.json / scripts.inc are GENERATED by tools/pelagios/build_*.py — fix the generator and regenerate, never hand-edit the output (a regen would clobber it)
metadata:
  type: feedback
---

Pelagios maps are produced by python generators under tools/pelagios/
(build_<island>.py for layouts/map.bin, build_<island>_mapjson.py for map.json,
build_<island>_scripts_stubs.py for scripts.inc stubs).

**Why:** hand-editing a generated file gets silently clobbered the next time anyone
reruns the generator. CLAUDE.md repeatedly says "regenerate via those scripts; do
NOT hand-edit map.bin/map.json/scripts.inc". When I fixed the Ironhold guard sprite,
sign positions, and added building stamps (2026-06-14), I changed the GENERATORS and
reran them so source and output stay in sync.

**How to apply:**
- To change an object's graphics_id / coords / warps / signs: edit build_*_mapjson.py
  then run it. To change layout tiles (buildings, walls, doors): edit build_*.py then
  run it (it rewrites data/layouts/<map>/map.bin). KEEP THE TWO IN SYNC — e.g. if a
  sign tile moves in the layout, move its sign() bg_event in the mapjson too.
- EXCEPTION: a scripts.inc is only stubbed once; once it contains a real `.string`
  line the stub generator won't touch it, so hand-editing scripts.inc is fine.
- EXCEPTION: src/data/heal_locations.json, layouts.json, region_map_*.json and the
  C headers are hand-or-tool-maintained data, not per-island regenerated — edit
  directly (carefully). If you find one truncated/corrupted by an in-flight session
  (e.g. a half-written entry breaking JSONPROC), restore a COMPLETE valid entry that
  matches sibling entries rather than deleting it, to preserve other sessions' work.
- After any generator change: rerun the generator, then `gmake -j$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu)`
  to exit 0. Prove tile fixes by metatile-ID-range analysis (see
  [[undressed-outdoor-layouts]]) since the emulator can't be run here.
